provenance.asset_description: Three illustrations over a blurred background. The image on the left is a Black Hole Nymph, a humanoid with vaguely elven features who wears a flowing dress of pure darkness lined with gold, evoking light bending around a black hole. The second image on the top right is a Sapient Ferrofluid Ooze, a creature made of a spiky black oozy substance. It has a goofy grin and human-like hands. The third image in the bottom right corner is an Oma, or space whale, a massive spacefaring creature with arcs of electricity running along its body.
